sources: WAFA (Palestinian news agency) via Tribune Online Nov 6; PressTV Nov 7 (via UNews); Abubaker Abed (Substack, Nov 7 02:16Z)
fault_line: A 15-year-old footballer shot dead while playing football during a 'ceasefire' -- is this a ceasefire at all, or a war that never stopped? (Note: no IDF account of the incident was available in-window.)

sections.what_happened: [ATTRIBUTED REPORT -- WAFA via Tribune Online, medical sources] Israeli gunfire killed 15-year-old Mohammed Nidal Barbakh in the al-Mawasi area of southern Gaza (Bir 19 area, west of Khan Younis); he was shot while playing football and later died of his injuries. [ATTRIBUTED REPORT -- PressTV via UNews, Nov 7] The child, named Mohammed Nidal Mohammed Awad Barbakh, aged 14, was killed by Israeli gunfire in the Mawasi area of Rafah while playing football with peers on Friday Nov 6; Gaza's Ministry of Education mourned him. [ADVOCACY FIGURE -- Abubaker Abed, Substack, UNVERIFIED] 'The number of footballers killed in Gaza has risen to 573. Over 100 of them are children.' [VERIFIED CONTEXT] Gaza Health Ministry toll since the Oct 2025 ceasefire stands at 1,602 killed / 5,799 wounded as of Thu Nov 6 (recorded 0900-07/1000-05); PressTV's own piece cites 1,593 -- scope discrepancy unresolved.
sections.what_verified: 2 distinct declared-tier families (WAFA T3 STATE PS + PressTV T3 STATE IR), both relaying Palestinian-side sources (WAFA: medical sources; PressTV: UNews/Gaza Education Ministry). Both are state-flagged and neither is independent of the Palestinian account; no Israeli response or IDF comment was reported in-window, and no second non-Palestinian-side family confirmed the incident. The killing itself is consistently reported by both families; the 'deliberately' framing is PressTV editorialising, not fact.
sections.what_disputed: DISCREPANCIES (unresolved): age 15 (WAFA/Tribune/Abed) vs 14 (PressTV); location al-Mawasi west of Khan Younis, Bir 19 area (WAFA) vs 'Mawasi area of Rafah' (PressTV) -- al-Mawasi is west of Khan Younis, near the Rafah border; the two descriptions may describe the same area loosely. The 573-footballers figure is an advocacy count from a single Substack post, unverified. No IDF statement on the incident surfaced in-window. The 1,593 vs 1,602 ceasefire tolls conflict (see 1000-05).
sections.why_matters: A named child, a football, a ceasefire that isn't one: Mohammed Barbakh, 15, Al-Najma academy, shot while playing football in al-Mawasi. Gaza toll lane, empathy beat -- name him, show the age/location discrepancies honestly, do not present PressTV's 'deliberately' as fact.
